title: amaryllis crociflora
intro: Amaryllis crociflora, commonly known as the Naked Lady or Zephyranthes candida, is a flowering plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Amaryllis crociflora include its ability to induce relaxation, reduce anxiety, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
